Name: Talkative Dinosaurs
Author: ViralTank
Description:
A very simple mod which changes Dinosaurs on your farm to use the frog croaking sounds (the same sounds used by Pepper Rex in the Skull Caverns).

To install, simply extract the .zip and copy the "Content" folder into your stardew valley install folder and let it overwrite. It's just an xnb replacer, so it doesn't need SMAPI or content patcher or anything.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
